abilities.name: Coffin Rigging
abilities.text: Once per round, after you resolve a salvage, yard, or machine sector, draw 1 Equipment. You may equip it if it is Armor.

abilities.name: Mortuary Triage
abilities.text: When you heal a Wound, you may also repair 1 exhausted Gear.

abilities.name: Grave Spark
abilities.text: Passive. Add +1 Forge on machine, lock, salvage, or dead-infrastructure tests.

abilities.name: Cold Brace
abilities.text: Once per round, when Wound damage would raise scenario pressure, reduce that pressure increase by 1. Weakness: Coffin Rigging cannot be used if you already gained Gear this turn.
